english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things that are not the same, distinct from one another, or noticeably unlike the usual.
Use 唔同 as the all-purpose way to say that two things or amounts are different.
This is the all-purpose choice when things differ from a statement, result, view, or each other.

examples.traditional: 呢兩杯咖啡個味道唔同。
examples.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 bui1 gaa3 fe1 go3 mei6 dou6 m4 tung4

examples.english: The flavors of these two coffees are unlike each other.
examples.traditional: 呢兩杯咖啡嘅味道唔同。
examples.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 bui1 gaa3 fe1 ge3 mei6 dou6 m4 tung4
ngo5 ge3 tai2 faat3 tung4 nei5 m4 tung4

english.note: Use this in everyday speech when “various” means simply different, especially before 嘅 + noun.

examples.english: There are various restaurants here; it depends what you want to eat.
examples.traditional: 呢度有唔同嘅餐廳，睇下你想食乜。
examples.jyutping: ni1 dou6 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 caan1 teng1 tai2 haa5 nei5 soeng2 sik6 mat1
